items.description: All 40 episodes of 'Extreme Ghostbusters', a slightly obscure horror comedy animated series based on the Ghostbusters franchise. It is a follow-up to the better known animated series 'The Real Ghostbusters'. Aired in syndication (BKN block) in the US and YTV in Canada.

items.title: PSX Longplay [304] Extreme Ghostbusters  - The Ultimate Invasion
items.description: Extreme Ghostbusters is based on the animated series that was a sequel to the 2 Ghostbusters movies. Extreme Ghostbusters was a short-lived, sequel/spin-off of The Real Ghostbusters, airing in the fall of 1997. The show featured a new team of younger Ghostbusters led by veteran Ghostbuster Egon Spen
